text:
maria-partners: Quick sync — BridgeKit (gateway adapter) + LangChain/LlamaIndex partner bundle: are we still aiming for a coordinated announcement with CloudVendor next month?
aj-ecosys: yes, target window W2 next month. need final confirmation on validated images from HW partner and an e2e smoke sign-off from eng.
simon-eng: We found a perf regression in the adapter when batching >8 on A100s with our kernel set. patch branch ready: `fix/bridgekit-batch-fallback`. looking for staging run tonight.
maria-partners: OK can we gate the announcement on the staging smoke pass + a joint FAQ? CloudVendor product marketing wants a short explainer on what BridgeKit unlocks for marketplace SI partners.
nate-pm: I'll draft the FAQ. question: do we call the bundle "BridgeKit + BridgeRuntimes" or something simpler? also need to confirm GUIDs for installer images.
aj-ecosys: go simpler: "BridgeKit bundle". Nate, ping me the FAQ draft by EOD Thu and i'll loop in CloudVendor PM.
simon-eng: Staging run scheduled 22:30 PT. DevOps: can you please ensure the validated image tag `bridgekit-v1.2-validated` exists in registry? deployment script we use: ```bash
./deploy_bridge.sh --image=redwood/bridgekit:bridgekit-v1.2-validated --env=staging
``` 
devops-bot: deploy pipeline queued. smoke tests: connectivity, token routing, kv-cache warmup, and latency under 120ms p50.
maria-partners: Also, marketing asks for a short partner quote from CloudVendor legal-approved contact. Aj, have you secured that?
aj-ecosys: waiting on legal signoff, should have a quote by Fri morning.
simon-eng: quick note — interop test harness uncovered inconsistent truncation when LlamaIndex chunk_size != gateway chunk_size. small fix in L32 of `adapter/serializer.py`. will include in the branch.
nate-pm: good catch, add to FAQ: recommended chunk_size parity and a troubleshooting step.
maria-partners: timeline check: staging green by Friday -> partner quote Fri AM -> FAQ + marketing assets Fri PM -> coordinated soft-annc Monday W2. sound realistic?
aj-ecosys: realistic if staging passes tonight and legal moves fast.
simon-eng: if staging fails, we fallback to soft announce without CloudVendor (announce on our marketplace only). but hopefully not. :crossed_fingers:
maria-partners: Agreed. I'll prepare the announcement checklist and blackout windows (no press on the day of CloudVendor's fiscal close). I'll post checklist here once draft ready.
devops-bot: staging run completed 1767770361 — status: SUCCESS. logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/bridgekit/1767770361
aj-ecosys: incredible. Simon, can you confirm the regression is fixed in the validation branch?
simon-eng: confirmed, batch fallback fix merged, interop truncation fix included. Running full e2e now.
maria-partners: Fantastic — I’ll lock in the CloudVendor PM and ask marketing to prep co-branded assets. Nate: can you put the FAQ draft into /docs/partnerships/bridgekit-faq.md and add the chunk_size note?
nate-pm: On it, will upload in ~2 hours and tag @aj-ecosys for review.
maria-partners: Thanks team — big cross-org win if we keep pace. :tada:
